development_failures: The first run failed one owner-policy assertion: the delegated compiler marks every action whose name contains DELETE, REMOVE or CLEAR as destructive, so ADD_REMOVE_KEYWORDS is a deletion even when it only adds. The fail-closed default was kept; the redundant removal check was dropped and the test and guide now state the behaviour.

Self-review before the first run replaced arrow-function never helpers with function declarations so that type narrowing holds, and corrected an expected changed field (a keyword Criteo never added differs on its present field).
limitations: Synthetic validation only; no live provider credentials, reads or account mutations in this batch.
Criteo keyword normalization is opaque; AMCP matches the supplied phrases case-insensitively within their match type and does not predict normalized phrases.
Keyword bids are in the retailer default currency; minimum bids and the line item maxBid bound are left to Criteo.
Keyword review, recommended keywords not listed on the line item, preferred line items, budget overrides, balance mapping and creatives are not part of this batch.
No GitHub CLI here and CAMCP is private: CI for the pushed commits was not read from this checkout.
No local Docker; container build/smoke evidence comes from GitHub Actions on the pushed commit.
